what_is_new: Known: *ḱlew- + 1sg pronoun for the god hearing a prayer (Vedic-Greek-Avestan). West pp. 316-317 also has the schema with an object, but the objects are not cognate (Ved. hávam RV 8.66.12, 1.122.6; Hitt. uttar CTH 381). The Greek anchors Il. 14.234 = 16.236 are cited by West, but for a different schema. vácas- = ἔπος is known only as a word equation. New: the cognate object *wékʷos (Ved. vácas- = Gk ἔπος) governed by *ḱlew- in prayer (RV 1.145.3b, 10.65.13c, AVŚ 6.2.1 ~ Il. 14.234 = 16.236). No source we hold states this collocation.
